name:        CheckboxList
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CheckboxList
description: CheckboxList shows a small group of checkboxes so users can turn several options on or off at once. Place it in settings pages, filter panels, or forms where every choice should be visible without scrolling. For a single standalone checkbox (like "I agree to the terms"), use CheckboxInput instead. If only one option can be picked, use RadioList. If the list is long enough to need searching or scrolling, use MultiSelector instead.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component CheckboxList

name:        CheckboxListItem
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CheckboxList
description: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a CheckboxList with a value array) or standalone mode (inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value, such as a select-all item). On a touch screen (a coarse primary pointer), a toggleable row is one press target: a touch on the label, the description or the box itself shows the pressed state on the row and its checkbox together. Where the primary pointer is fine, the box keeps its own press.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component CheckboxListItem
